svg.title: MAF conversion
svg.desc: Two MAF blocks on chr1 overlap the BED locus geneA (chr1:100–115). SEGUL joins them into one alignment named geneA-chr1-100-115. panTro6 is missing from block 2, so its part is filled with gaps: hg38 ACGT--ACGTACGGCCA, panTro6 ACGTTTACGTAC-----, mm10 ACGA--ACGTACGGCTA.
